Humanoid (Dwarf) · 1 hex · SM -1 Deep Dwarf [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: humanoid folk and their sub-races; answers Deep Dwarf (SRD 3.5)]

Dwarves who went down and kept going, until the sun stopped being a thing they had an opinion about. Deep dwarves see in the dark better than anything with eyes has any business doing and are correspondingly miserable in daylight. They are hard to kill in the specific, literal way a person becomes when everything around them has been trying for four hundred years.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/deep-dwarf.gct
  • Independent build total: 68 points of racial traits plus 18 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Deep Dwarf (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 70 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 4 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • About 1.4 m standing, which is the SM -1 row.
  • ST 11: broad through the shoulder and short in the arm, which is more lift than height suggests and less reach than a human's.
  • Dark Vision rather than Infravision. A deep dwarf works a face with no lamp at all, which Infravision would not allow.
  • Light sensitivity is recorded on the encounter block rather than as a trait: the penalty is to acting in daylight, not damage taken from it, and the vocabulary has no published trait that says only that.
  • Mail and a shield are the usual kit and are not in this record's DR. See decision 11 in the build policy.
